edition.title: Between The Buttons
edition.notes:
Has maroon labels with matrix numbers that appear without brackets.
Band name and album title are in all lower-case letters.
The font used for the title and artist is bold and broad. 
Side indications read ''Side 1'' and ''Side 2''.

Runouts feature scratched out portions represented by #.
The lone T in runouts is stamped upside-down in relation to the primary data.

May have Between The Buttons Promotional Sticker.
